answers.why: This is a stretch of Colombo roadside seen from the street: no interior spaces are used in the scenes and it is a linear public frontage rather than a vehicle.

layout: A narrow concrete pavement runs along the right side of a patched dark-asphalt road, separated from the carriageway by an open kerb drainage with removable concrete slabs and grates. A row of weathered low-rise commercial frontages with metal shutters recedes along the pavement; a modest two-storey concrete building with a balcony and a small open vending bay under a blue tarpaulin sits in the near foreground. Concrete boundary walls, utility poles and overhead cables line the pavement edge; mature trees and distant low buildings mark the far end of the street. Surfaces are muted grey, dusty beige and leaf-green, with rain-wet reflections and occasional subdued amber shop light from the vending bay.

views.camera: On the wet road a little way from the pavement, looking down the length of the roadside toward the vanishing point.
views.sees: Near foreground: patched dark asphalt and the open kerb drainage running beside the pavement (right). Centre-right: the narrow concrete pavement, the modest two-storey building with balcony and the illuminated vending bay under a blue tarpaulin. Left and far: the row of shuttered low-rise commercial frontages, utility poles and overhead cables receding into tree-lined distance.

views.camera: Standing on the pavement beside the vending bay, looking left along the pavement and road.
views.sees: Right foreground: the vending-bay frontage and the base of the concrete building. Centre and far left: a continuous line of shuttered shopfronts, utility poles and cables receding into a misty, tree-lined distance; the wet road reflecting pale sky.

views.camera: On the pavement facing the nearby building and boundary wall, looking across the pavement toward the immediate frontage.
views.sees: Centre-right: the two-storey concrete building with balcony and its green-painted wall, the compact vending bay tucked beneath the overhang. Near-right: the concrete boundary wall and a utility pole; the edge of the open kerb drainage with its slab covers close to the camera.

views.camera: Turned around from the wide, standing on the road and looking across to the opposite side of the street and the sky above.
views.sees: Centre and far: the wet carriageway stretching back toward distant buildings and tree canopy, overhead cables cutting across the frame, and soft early-morning or evening light reflected on the asphalt; the opposite pavement and low buildings seen as a muted band at the far side.

views.camera: Close to the vending bay, tight on the open-front stall under the tarpaulin, looking straight at its counter and shelving.
views.sees: Centre: the small open vending bay with shelves of goods, a low counter/table and subdued amber bulbs casting warm light on weathered surfaces and plastic crates; near-left the blue tarpaulin awning and the damp concrete threshold.

views.camera: Low, near the pavement edge, looking down along the open kerb drainage and slabbed covers.
views.sees: Near foreground: the rectangular concrete slab covers and open channel of the kerb drainage at the pavement edge; nearby wet pavement and the dark patched asphalt of the road showing rain reflections and debris-coloured stains.
